author: Linda Williams
text: After a slight delay due to unforeseen circumstances they were able to take  care of my septic system, even before my scheduled appointment.  Thank you Fix Family Enterprises for your prompt service.

author: Pavel Gromnic
text: Fix Family Staff are invariably courteous, helpful and efficient. It's a difficult job, but they're really good at it. We don't see them very frequently, but country living presents a lot of opportunities to meet new friends like these.

author: Jane M
text: Fix is the best, and reasonably priced too. I’ve been using them since 2008 and wouldn’t use anyone else. They’re very nice too!

author: Cheryl Bradway
text: I was in desperate need of landscaping and Fix Family came in at a decent price and transformed my flower garden. Sam was very easy to work with and she was quick to answer questions I had and provide options for me until I had the flowers that worked best.  Am looking forward to working with them on other projects as well!

author: Matthew Borton
text: On time, Excellent service. Open communication and very knowledgeable. Easy to schedule. A great family business in our area. They are our go to for all their services.
